format: newline-delimited JSON, one publication per row
required_window_field: publication_date (new exports); filing_date only for explicitly labeled legacy imports
authentication: AWS Workload Identity Federation through the EC2 role
status: federation_and_query_access_verified; bounded historical collection available; recurring export not scheduled
notes: This S3 prefix stores exports. It does not create a Google Cloud project or run BigQuery queries.
Inbox files are not curated Athena tables. patent_bigquery_collection.py writes both exports and shared research records; patent_collection.py imports existing standalone files.
Completion of a file import means the file was processed, not that worldwide patent coverage is complete.
Global source freshness and query cost must be checked before enabling recurring exports.
